steps.meaning: Pelham Savings Bank accepts a wire instruction for $46,000 to Delacroix Farms' verified account before 3:00 PM Eastern on 30 October 2026.
steps.name: wire_acceptance

steps.meaning: An authorized signer submits the wire instruction via Pelham's business banking portal before the cutoff.
steps.name: wire_submission
steps.uncertainty: It is uncertain whether an authorized signer will submit the wire instruction before the cutoff.

steps.meaning: At least one person who is an authorized signer on the trust's account is available and willing to submit the wire before the cutoff.
steps.name: authorized_signer_available
steps.uncertainty: It is uncertain whether any authorized signer is available.

steps.meaning: Marguerite Okonjo is an authorized signer on the trust's account (either as interim executive director or otherwise).
steps.name: okonjo_authorized
steps.uncertainty: It is uncertain whether Okonjo is an authorized signer; the evidence does not state whether the bank was notified or whether the signature card was amended.

steps.meaning: Another person (e.g., board chair Aksoy) is an authorized signer and available.
steps.name: other_authorized_signer
steps.uncertainty: It is uncertain whether any other person is an authorized signer; the signature card only names Executive Director and Treasurer, both unavailable.

steps.meaning: The wire template with Delacroix Farms' verified account and $46,000 amount is saved in Pelham's portal.
steps.name: wire_template_ready

steps.meaning: The trust's account holds at least $46,000 on 30 October 2026.
steps.name: sufficient_funds
